attr.title: Pocket Tracker Extreme
attr.desc: Pocket Tracker Extreme 0.2.0-beta.2: native music studio for TrimUI Brick / KNULLI. Synth engines, sampling, slicing, groove generation, performance effects and mastering. Direct iPhone recording failed in the current user setup; class-compliant interfaces remain separately untested.
attr.inst: For a new installation, extract the full ZIP into roms/ports. Existing users should use the program-only update to retain all app files and data. Launch from Ports; no PortMaster startup dependency. Read README.txt.
